metadata.title: Digital Mine: illustrative haulage cycles
metadata.author: DeepSkill course materials
metadata.source: Authored teaching fixture with explicitly chosen values, not sensor measurements or simulator output.
metadata.purpose: Explain data types, aggregation and interpretation in session 07; not a reference implementation of the mining simulator.
metadata.grain: One completed cycle, including initial loading queue, loading, loaded travel, unloading and empty return.
assumptions: Eight complete cycles across four invented trucks and two invented routes; four cycles per route.
All payloads are set to 80 tonnes for this example; this does not specify fleet capacity.
Durations are selected to create visible differences in waiting and travel. No fitted distribution, random draw, stochastic seed or calibration is used.
R-01 waiting times are 2, 3, 4, 3 minutes. Loaded travel is 8, 9, 10, 9 minutes. Empty return is 8 minutes.
R-02 waiting times are 6, 8, 10, 8 minutes. Loaded and empty travel are each 10, 11, 12, 11 minutes.
Loading takes 4 minutes and unloading 2 minutes in every cycle. No other waiting or downtime is modeled.
Service aggregates loading and unloading. Travel aggregates loaded haulage and empty return. The chart shows unweighted arithmetic means per cycle.
The values are neither representative of a real mine nor evidence that Digital Mine is implemented or calibrated.
